meanings.3: strong/mature with a notable gap or current reliability caveat
meanings.4: strong and directly supported/accepted for the measured workflow

scoring.warning: Scores are engineering measurement only. A lower WAG score does not automatically authorize implementation.

desktopCommander: recent public Remote MCP OAuth/session issues #600, #622, #698 used only as reliability caveats
evidenceBasis.limitation: No live Desktop Commander connector calls were used for this matrix; comparison uses current public product documentation and recent public reliability reports.

rows.wagEvidence: WAG one-command setup exists, but external clean-Windows acceptance and first-time account provisioning remain incomplete.
rows.desktopCommanderEvidence: DC documents npx setup, onboarding, auto-update install modes and broad client setup.

rows.category: Manual steps to WebChat/remote first use
rows.wagEvidence: Existing ChatGPT connector workflow passes; clean first-time tunnel/runtime-key/connector flow still crosses external account steps.
rows.desktopCommanderEvidence: DC remote uses device OAuth plus separate AI connector OAuth; documented guided flow but still multi-step.

rows.wagEvidence: M1 real reboot PASS; service, tunnel, DevSpace, WSL and collision failures accepted; M4 update/rollback live PASS.
rows.desktopCommanderEvidence: DC documents persisted remote sessions/reconnect, but recent public issues show hosted OAuth/session regressions.

rows.wagEvidence: WAG exposes bounded machine read/read_many/list/mkdir/move/delete plus reviewed file create/edit/replace.
rows.desktopCommanderEvidence: DC exposes read/write/create/list/move and edit_block.

rows.wagEvidence: WAG has machine.search/search_continue but no product search-cancel or active-search inventory.
rows.desktopCommanderEvidence: DC exposes start_search/get_more_search_results/stop_search/list_searches.

rows.wagEvidence: WAG exposes process start/list/inspect/terminate and persistent terminal open/input/output/close with identity revalidation.
rows.desktopCommanderEvidence: DC exposes interactive processes, session lists, output paging, kill and long-running command control.

rows.wagEvidence: WAG has PDF text extraction/image read and generic command execution, but no native bounded DOCX/XLSX create/edit surface and no rich PDF create/edit API.
rows.desktopCommanderEvidence: DC documents native Excel read/write/edit/search, PDF read/create/modify and DOCX read/create/edit/search.

rows.wagEvidence: WAG supports images, PDF extraction and browser screenshots; preview UX is client-dependent and format coverage is narrower.
rows.desktopCommanderEvidence: DC documents visual file preview plus images, directories, PDF, Excel and DOCX extraction/display.

rows.wagEvidence: WAG can use argv/process execution but has no dedicated bounded in-memory analysis tool.
rows.desktopCommanderEvidence: DC explicitly supports in-memory Python, Node.js and R execution.

rows.wagEvidence: M3 doctor/failure matrix and bounded repair PASS; health and diagnostics usage/recent tools are live.
rows.desktopCommanderEvidence: DC exposes recent tool calls/usage/config and debug modes; no equivalent published destructive acceptance matrix found.

rows.wagEvidence: M4 transactional staging, post-switch health, automatic rollback, explicit rollback and fixture uninstall semantics PASS; live update+rollback PASS.
rows.desktopCommanderEvidence: DC documents npx auto-update and remove/uninstall flows, but not transactional previous-version rollback semantics.

rows.wagEvidence: WAG existing ChatGPT Web connector works and private MCP/stdio surfaces exist, but broad external client acceptance is not complete.
rows.desktopCommanderEvidence: DC documents Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code/Copilot, Cline, Roo, Claude Code, Codex, JetBrains, Gemini CLI, Augment, Qwen and Remote MCP.

rows.wagEvidence: WAG hosted multi-device architecture is intentionally gated to M7; current product is local-first.
rows.desktopCommanderEvidence: DC remote documents OAuth device pairing, persisted sessions, dashboard revoke and multi-machine control; current hosted OAuth regressions reduce reliability score.

rows.wagEvidence: WAG M1/M3 carry measured destructive/local synthetic failure evidence plus real reboot.
rows.desktopCommanderEvidence: DC docs include troubleshooting and reconnect behavior; no comparable public full failure-injection matrix was found.

rows.wagEvidence: WAG uses bounded roots/effect policy, DPAPI-protected local runtime material and avoids persistent admin credential paths.
rows.desktopCommanderEvidence: DC warns allowedDirectories do not constrain terminal commands; remote device credentials persist locally and Windows code does not set a custom owner-only ACL.

rows.wagEvidence: WAG has effect correlation, durable verify/mutation records, result chunks and explicit consequential-effect controls.
rows.desktopCommanderEvidence: DC provides local tool-call history/audit previews but no published equivalent exactly-once/durable effect model.

rows.wagEvidence: WAG config remains mostly file/setup/doctor driven; no stable user-facing get/set config tool family yet.
rows.desktopCommanderEvidence: DC exposes get_config/set_config_value with dynamic changes.

rows.wagEvidence: WAG exposes diagnostics.recent/diagnostics.usage but lacks a product-level feedback/help/config workflow family.
rows.desktopCommanderEvidence: DC exposes get_usage_stats, get_recent_tool_calls and feedback flow.

rows.wagEvidence: WAG has 7 BrowserPort tools: open/describe/snapshot/exec/effect.get/screenshot/close.
rows.desktopCommanderEvidence: DC core documented tool surface is filesystem/terminal/process/document oriented; no comparable native browser harness is listed.

rows.wagEvidence: WAG has repository inspection, durable file mutations, verify, git commit and bounded remote git push with correlation.
rows.desktopCommanderEvidence: DC can perform Git through terminal/files but its public tool table does not expose a comparable specialized reviewed Git-effect surface.

measuredM6Candidates.blockedWorkflow: Long-running/large-tree searches cannot be enumerated or cancelled as a product-level session; continuation exists but lifecycle control is incomplete.
measuredM6Candidates.evidence: Desktop Commander exposes start/get-more/stop/list search sessions; WAG exposes machine.search/search_continue only.
measuredM6Candidates.existingWagAlternative: machine.search + machine.search_continue; command/process tools for ad hoc cancellation.
measuredM6Candidates.acceptanceTest: Start multiple large searches; list only active owned searches; cancel one; verify no orphan worker/result leak; continuation tokens remain bounded and invalid after cancellation.

measuredM6Candidates.blockedWorkflow: Non-coding users cannot reliably inspect/create/edit XLSX and DOCX or create/modify PDFs without shell/tool-specific glue.
measuredM6Candidates.evidence: Desktop Commander documents native Excel/PDF/DOCX workflows; WAG currently has PDF extraction/images and generic execution only.
measuredM6Candidates.existingWagAlternative: machine command execution, PDF extract, image read, external Python/Node libraries.
measuredM6Candidates.acceptanceTest: Format-specific round trips inside allowed roots; preserve formulas/styles/relationships where promised; reject path traversal, zip bombs, malformed OOXML/PDF; verify atomic writes and rollback.

measuredM6Candidates.blockedWorkflow: Users lack a simple product surface to inspect/update safe settings and review recent activity without reading config files.
measuredM6Candidates.evidence: DC exposes get/set config, usage stats, recent tool calls and feedback; WAG has diagnostics but not equivalent product UX APIs.
measuredM6Candidates.existingWagAlternative: setup CLI, doctor, config files, diagnostics.recent/usage.
measuredM6Candidates.acceptanceTest: Schema-bounded config keys only; compare-and-swap writes; secrets never returned; activity pagination bounded; unsupported keys fail closed.

measuredM6Candidates.blockedWorkflow: Transactional update exists but doctor still reports update channel discovery as unconfigured.
measuredM6Candidates.evidence: M4 lifecycle accepted; M3 update status remains UNCONFIGURED. DC npx install paths auto-resolve latest on restart.
measuredM6Candidates.existingWagAlternative: Explicit local release package passed to update command.
measuredM6Candidates.acceptanceTest: Signed/channel-pinned metadata fetch; compatible release selection; no auto-switch without lifecycle acceptance; offline/stale metadata deterministic.

measuredM6Candidates.blockedWorkflow: Short data transformations require generic process/argv execution and may create temporary files or inherit broader environment than necessary.
measuredM6Candidates.evidence: DC explicitly advertises in-memory Python/Node/R; WAG has generic execution.
measuredM6Candidates.acceptanceTest: Strict runtime/output/memory limits; explicit filesystem/network flags; scrubbed credential inheritance; no background child survival.

deferred.reason: M7/M8; do not mix hosted relay into local plane implicitly
Roadmap explicitly rejects adding large raw-tool batches without measured workflows
